Figure 17:  Mapping of N-PDUs to N-PDU-Pools
An FrTpTxPduPool could be referenced by different FrTpConnections (see also
chapter 7.3.2.2). Depending on the number of currently active FrTpConnections
the bandwidth (N-PDUs) is shared between them 24 . By supporting dynamic
bandwidth assignment, a support of different communication scenarios is possible.
Figure 18 depicts two different scenarios which could be supported with only one
FrTp configuration. From gateway’s point of view different communication scenarios
are possible:
a)  single connection communication
Complete bandwidth (slots) is assigned to one communication link (e.g. to
ECU 2)
b)  multiple connection communication
Bandwidth (slots) is shared between different communication links to different
ECUs (e.g. ECU 1-3).
